about.heroSubtitle: OceanicJob was born from a dream: to help young graduates from Madagascar, Comoros, Mauritius and all Indian Ocean islands find employment with dignity, without corruption, without favoritism.
about.storyPart1: OceanicJob is much more than a job platform. It's a social mission born in 2014 thanks to the vision of Noureddine ABDALLAH, who dreamed of connecting Indian Ocean talents to the world of work.
about.storyPart2: Today, taken over and improved by Sidi ABDILLAH SIDI and Ibrahim DJOUMOI, OceanicJob continues this mission with modern technology and renewed ambition.
about.storyQuote: In Madagascar and the islands, many brilliant young graduates cannot find work. Not because they lack skills, but because they don't know 'someone's uncle'. We want to change that.

problemList.orientation: Lack of career guidance after studies

solutionList.transparent: Transparent and accessible platform for all
solutionList.connection: Connection with French, Canadian and European companies
solutionList.solidarity: Mutual support between Indian Ocean islands

about.opportunityText: Today, many French, Canadian and European companies outsource their services to Africa. They are looking for qualified and competitive workforce.
about.opportunityHighlight: This is a unique opportunity for us, Africans!
about.opportunityDetails: Web development, customer service, accounting, design, digital marketing... Thousands of jobs are accessible from Madagascar and the Indian Ocean islands. OceanicJob is the portal that connects you to these opportunities.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At OceanicJob, we take the protection of your personal data very seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information.
privacy.rgpdText: This policy complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) of the European Union.

dataCollection.title: Data we collect
dataCollection.item1: Identification information: name, email address, phone number
dataCollection.item2: Professional information: CV, experience, skills, education
dataCollection.item3: Connection data: IP address, browser type, pages visited
dataCollection.item4: Application information: cover letters, job preferences

dataUse.title: How we use your data
dataUse.item1: To create and manage your user account
dataUse.item2: To connect you with potential employers
dataUse.item3: To improve our services and your user experience
dataUse.item4: To send you notifications about relevant job offers

dataSecurity.title: Data security
dataSecurity.item3: Regular security audits of our infrastructure

dataSharing.title: Data sharing
dataSharing.item1: Your data is never sold to third parties
dataSharing.item2: Sharing with employers only when you apply

yourRights.title: Your rights (GDPR)
yourRights.item1: Right of access: view all your personal data
yourRights.item2: Right to rectification: correct your information
yourRights.item3: Right to erasure: delete your account and data
yourRights.item4: Right to portability: export your data
yourRights.item5: Right to object: refuse certain processing

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.item2: Analytics cookies to improve our services
cookies.item3: You can manage your preferences in your browser

privacy.contactUs: Our team is available to answer all your questions about data protection.
